en.title: air conditioning refrigerant
en.summary: The gas that circulates in the air conditioning. In Spanish it is called gas refrigerante, which is not the engine coolant — that is refrigerante on its own, and the two are never mixed up on this site.

es.title: gas refrigerante
es.summary: El gas que circula en el aire acondicionado. Ojo con la palabra: el refrigerante a secas es el del motor, y en este sitio los dos nunca se confunden.
